current_motion_lead: Task_0017 smoothing completes safely at 804 actions; contemporaneous identity completes unsafely at 1261. Default caps do not bind in that smoothing trajectory. This single comparison merits repetition but does not establish a causal repair. On task_0002 both smoothing and identity complete safely; on task_0013 smoothing remains unfinished while identity completes safely.
retry_scope: All four trials analyzed. Five five-action retreats occur across three episodes, with measured distances 14.56 to 14.90 mm against 15 mm requested; no active retry trial completes safely. One retreat occurs after a tipping violation. The fourth trial never triggers and completes unsafely. No recovery benefit established.

horizon_16_comparison.task_0002: Safe completion at 755 actions and 48 queries, compared with contemporaneous horizon-8 identity at 757 actions and 95 queries. A single-scene query-efficiency lead, not an established population effect.
horizon_16_comparison.task_0008: Safe unfinished at 2000 actions and 125 queries, versus safe completion for the contemporaneous horizon-8 control.
horizon_16_comparison.task_0013: Unsafe completion at 1527 actions and 96 queries; first violation is off-support before closure at 1473. The contemporaneous horizon-8 control completed safely.

guard_lead: Task_0017 remains a promising single-trial contrast, but across all four scenes the plain guard and repeated identity both have 3 safe completions; hand-back has 2. The hand-back task_0002 run stays safely unfinished without closure or grasp, using 1633 queries. The repeated four-condition comparison remains queued.
